cases.name: etaf-export-registers-with-etaf-ext-and-exposes-key-layer
cases.purpose: etaf-export registers cleanly with etaf-ext (icon, tone, commands), contributes export bindings to etaf-help-data, opens its floating popup, and reports rsvg-convert status via etaf-export-doctor.

cases.name: etaf-export-svg-and-pdf-paginated-a4-single-and-light-remap
cases.purpose: etaf-export exports a mounted multi-section dark ETAF page to multi-page A4 PDF, continuous single-page PDF, and light-remapped white-paper SVG/PDF without mutating the live buffer.

cases.name: etaf-export-embeds-vector-svg-with-scoped-ids-and-raster-images
cases.purpose: etaf-export embeds inline vector SVG graphics with scoped fragment IDs (avoiding rasterization) alongside PNG images and produces a valid vector PDF.

cases.name: etaf-export-signals-structured-errors-for-invalid-inputs
cases.purpose: etaf-export-pdf and etaf-export-svg reject invalid page-mode, theme, missing runtime or missing rsvg-convert with etaf-export-error.
